Talent0_2Ability.name: Pioneer Of Paradox
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: The piloted ST can use different forms with unique effect and can be equipped with separated weapons and backpacks for each form. At the start of action and upon triggering <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf>, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900199>[Particle Energy]</buf>. Accumulating <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks allows the usage of <skill activeSkill=8001504>[Particle Burst]</skill> to remove <skill passiveSkill=800159>[Virtual Particle Form]</skill> restriction. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Pioneer Of Paradox
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
The piloted ST can use different forms with unique effect and can be equipped with separated weapons and backpacks for each form. At the start of action and upon triggering <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf>, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900199>[Particle Energy]</buf>. Accumulating <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks allows the usage of <skill activeSkill=8001504>[Particle Burst]</skill> to remove <skill passiveSkill=800159>[Virtual Particle Form]</skill> restriction. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
At the start of action, gains corresponding <buf ID=900157>[Form Buff]</buf> based on current form. While carrying <buf ID=900157>[Form Buff]</buf>, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

800101.name: Form Shift 1
800101.SpecificEffects: At the end of action, if other allies can still act, enters <buf ID=900154>[Pending Activation]</buf> state. If an ally actively attacks with weapon corresponding to a form, triggers <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> to enter the corresponding <buf ID=900156>[Form Shift]</buf>. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

400902.name: Ultimate Mastery
400902.SpecificEffects: When HP percentage is <color=#F74848>50%</color> or more, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color> and DMG taken reduces by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

800103.name: Deep Analysis
800103.SpecificEffects: When actively attacked, if the corresponding weapon type is equipped, DMG taken reduces by <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

800104.name: Thousand-Form Weapon
800104.describe:

800105.name: Form Synchronization
800105.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> is triggered, gains <buf ID=7100703>[Defensive Stance III]</buf>, effective for <color=#F74848>1</color> times. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

800106.name: Restructure
800106.describe: Gains <color=#F74848>2</color> AP and <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=900199>[Particle Energy]</buf>, also refreshes all buffs duration. Can move <color=#F74848>3</color> additional tiles before attacking.

800107.name: Energy Circulation
800107.SpecificEffects: While in <skill passiveSkill=800159>[Virtual Particle Form]</skill>, if possesses <color=#F74848>5</color> or less AP, consumes <color=#F74848>1</color> PP to recover <color=#F74848>3</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Gains <color=#F74848>2</color> PP at the start of battle.

800108.name: Virtual Particle Protocol
800108.describe: <skill passiveSkill=800159>[Virtual Particle Form]</skill> inherent skills are improved to <skill activeSkill=7300432>[Particle Blade EX]</skill>, <skill activeSkill=7300442>[Particle Cannon EX]</skill> and <skill activeSkill=7300452>[Particle Matrix EX]</skill>. Additionally, <skill activeSkill=7300461>[World Chaser]</skill> can be used.

hiddenSkills.name: Cluster Matrix
hiddenSkills.describe:
Launches <color=#F74848>1</color> attack based on the current form and equipped weapon. The attack multiplier and effect vary based on weapon type.
Vanguard: <skill mainSkill=730016>[Weakness Strike]</skill><skill activeSkill=7300172>[Spear Strike]</skill><skill activeSkill=7300192>[Saw Strike]</skill><skill activeSkill=7300212>[Blade Strike]</skill><skill activeSkill=7300232>[Snipe]</skill><skill activeSkill=7300252>[Lock-On]</skill>.

Tactical: <skill activeSkill=7300352>[Piercing Wind]</skill><skill activeSkill=7300372>[Sweeping Barrage]</skill><skill activeSkill=7300392>[Magnetized Shot]</skill><skill activeSkill=7300412>[Floating Cannon]</skill>.

800111.name: Form Shift 2
800111.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> is triggered, gains <color=#F74848>2</color> AP.

800121.name: Form Shift 3
800121.SpecificEffects: When attacking, DMG calculation uses the highest value of all pilot attributes.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

800131.name: Guiding Dawn Star 1
800131.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> is triggered, grants <color=#F74848>1</color> random buffs to all allies within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

800133.name: Form Shift 4
800133.SpecificEffects:
At the start of action, enables <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> trigger for <color=#F74848>2</color> forms other than the current one for <color=#F74848>1</color> time each.
When all allies have ended their turn, if [Hailis] is in <buf ID=900154>[Pending Activation]</buf> state, triggers <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> for current form, gaining <color=#F74848>1</color> extra turn, but cannot gain <buf ID=900199>[Particle Energy]</buf>. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

800134.name: Guiding Dawn Star 2
800134.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> is triggered, grants corresponding <buf ID=900157>[Form Buff]</buf> to all allies.

800135.name: Guiding Dawn Star 3
800135.SpecificEffects: At the start of action, if <color=#F74848>2</color> or more <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> was triggered in previous turn, all allies DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

800136.name: Guiding Dawn Star 4
800136.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf>, if [Hailis] is on the field, the next ally attack or command skill costs <color=#F74848>1</color> less AP, to a minimum of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. This effect is removed after any ally uses an attack or command skill.

800141.name: Singularity Deferrence 1
800141.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> is triggered, gains <buf ID=900157>[Form Buff]</buf> based on current form as well as <color=#F74848>1</color> random buff, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

800144.name: Singularity Deferrence 2
800144.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf>, next attack cost <color=#F74848>-1</color> AP, to a minimum of <color=#F74848>1</color>. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

800145.name: Singularity Deferrence 3
800145.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf> for <color=#F74848>3</color> different forms, DMG dealt increases <color=#F74848>25%</color> till the end of battle.

800146.name: Singularity Deferrence 4
800146.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900155>[Activation]</buf>, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part and <color=#F74848>7.5%</color> HP to all intact parts. Also deals <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> equal to <color=#F74848>15%</color> of this unit body part max HP to all enemies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles.
